name: url
label: URL
help: The path after /apps/{app ID}, such as /channels, /channels/presence-room-1/users, /events, /batch_events or /users/42/terminate_connections. See https://hibira.io/docs.

name: query
label: Query string
help: Without the auth_ parameters, which are added for you, such as filter_by_prefix=presence-&info=user_count.

name: body
label: Body
help: JSON, such as {"name": "order-shipped", "channels": ["orders"], "data": "{}"}. Leave it empty for GET.
